name: trica
description: Offline trigonometry triangle solver. Trica = TRIgonometry CAlculation.

scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -n tsc,sass,server -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run tsc:watch" "npm run style:watch" "npm run start"
scripts.dev:no-sw: npx --yes concurrently -n tsc,sass,server -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run tsc:watch" "npm run style:watch" "npm run start -- --middleware=$PWD/scripts/disable-sw.js"
